TikTokDirectPostPhotoConfig.description:
Publish a photo carousel directly to the creator's TikTok profile. Photos
are pulled by TikTok from public URLs. Requires video.publish scope.

photo_urls.description: Comma-separated public image URLs in carousel order (up to 10). JPEG or WebP only (TikTok rejects PNG). Each must be reachable by TikTok — use the upload button on another node or {{http-1.response.url}} to host images.
photo_urls.title: Photo URLs

privacy_level.description: Who can see the post. The creator's account settings can restrict which levels are allowed — use Query Creator Info to confirm the available options for an account.
privacy_level.title: Privacy Level

photo_cover_index.description: Zero-based index of the photo to use as the cover.
photo_cover_index.title: Cover Photo Index

TikTokDirectPostPhotoConfig.title: TikTokDirectPostPhotoConfig

TikTokDirectPostVideoConfig.description:
Publish a video directly to the creator's TikTok profile via FILE_UPLOAD
(the bytes are uploaded straight to TikTok, no public URL needed). Requires
the video.publish scope.

video_url.description: The video to post — upload a file, paste a URL, or reference an upstream file (e.g. {{http-1.response.url}}). The bytes are uploaded directly to TikTok (MP4 recommended, max 64 MB).
video_url.title: Video

title.description: Video caption (max 2200 characters). Hashtags and @mentions are supported.
title.title: Caption

privacy_level.description: Who can see the post. The creator's account settings can restrict which levels are allowed — use Query Creator Info to confirm the available options for an account.
privacy_level.title: Privacy Level

video_cover_timestamp_ms.description: Timestamp in milliseconds of the frame to use as the cover image.
video_cover_timestamp_ms.title: Cover Frame (ms)

TikTokOAuthCredential.description:
OAuth 2.0 credential for TikTok Open Platform.
Tokens are obtained via TikTok OAuth flow, not entered manually.

Register your app at: https://developers.tiktok.com/
Access tokens expire in 24 hours; refresh tokens rotate on each refresh.

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token

expires_at.title: Token Expiry

refresh_expires_at.title: Refresh Token Expiry

open_id.description: The authenticated user's unique TikTok ID for this app
open_id.title: Open ID

display_name.description: The authenticated user's TikTok display name
display_name.title: Display Name

avatar_url.description: URL of the authenticated user's profile picture

TikTokPublishVideoConfig.description:
Upload a video to TikTok creator inbox as a draft via PULL_FROM_URL (requires video.upload scope).
The creator receives an inbox notification and can review/edit before posting.
To publish straight to the profile instead, use the Direct Post Video operation.

video_url.description: The video to send — upload a file, paste a URL, or reference an upstream file (e.g. {{http-1.response.url}}). MP4 recommended, max 64 MB. Must be publicly accessible by TikTok's servers.
video_url.title: Video URL
